features.behavior: Triage starts from the reviewer-finished signal, not from an agent electing to look.
Review-vs-notice is read from harness/review-attestation.json; adding a reviewer changes behaviour with no code edit.
A finding's class comes from a declared marker; absent marker yields unclassified, never a prose parse.
A REAL finding is not applied until its claimed defect reproduces.
A mutation that does not land reports did-not-land, distinct from did-not-reproduce.
A refuted REAL finding is recorded as refuted with evidence, not silently skipped.
A PR carrying an undispositioned reviewer comment cannot close or merge.
Every check has a red-direction test observed failing.
